descriptions.value: The Okta Hyperdrive Integration plugin resolves a required assembly using a registry path within the current user's hive without integrity verification. The referenced path is loaded via Assembly.LoadFrom without signature validation, resulting in an unverified assembly executing within the context of the host process or elevated installer.

assertions.title: Improper Assembly Resolution in Okta Hyperdrive Integration Plugin Registry Handling

title: Improper Assembly Resolution in Okta Hyperdrive Integration Plugin Registry Handling
